name: Mirror-Blooded One, Lend Me Your Grace

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target gains +1 Fortitude and suppresses one ordinary Slowed Condition until the start of your next turn; it may move 1 unit.

surges.html: The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Fey
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Fey Full Manifestation (FM-2F). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
